Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: original widescreen 16:9 background artwork for the Mandate Wallet technical presentation.
Primary request: a premium cinematic abstract metallic flow, inspired by the depth and sculptural brushed-chrome ribbons of contemporary DeFi presentations, in Mandate's graphite, silver and electric blue palette. Create an original composition, not a copy of another brand.
Scene/backdrop: extremely dark graphite navy studio, subtle luminous blue atmospheric haze, not flat pure black.
Subject: on the right half, several huge smooth folded graphite-titanium ribbons arc and twist in an elegant fluid loop, their layered edges catching cool silver and vivid blue rim light. Macro sculptural material, expensive polished industrial design. Curves flow off the right and bottom edges. The object is abstract and does not resemble a letter or logo.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape, 2560x1440-style clarity. Keep left 62% mostly dark and visually quiet for an existing white logo and headline. Keep bottom left quiet for four team names. Sculptural highlight concentration at x=78% y=45%, softer atmospheric traces near top and bottom. Strong depth but no busy detail.
Lighting/mood: sophisticated, futuristic, confident; a controlled bright cobalt highlight and silver specular edges, deep navy reflections, subtle film grain.
Constraints: background artwork only. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no diagram, no UI. No robot, no coin, no stars, no random particles, no cryptocurrency symbols. No hard panel boundaries or borders. Preserve generous copy space.

Composition/framing: widescreen 16:9. Keep the central 90% of the slide a calm very dark low-contrast navy graphite gradient, particularly from x=5% to 94% and y=15% to 91%, reserved for dense system diagrams.
